text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division. Mathematics Syllabus Primary One to Six (implementation starting with the 2021 Primary One cohort; updated October 2025). Area and Perimeter: pp. 36 and 39; Length: pp. 32 and 34.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司：《小学一至六年级数学课程纲要》（2021 年版，2025 年 10 月更新）。面积与周长：第 36、39 页；长度：第 32、34 页。

note.en: The only source for what each step covers; the syllabus lines in the lesson are quoted from it, including "excluding conversion between cm2 and m2" (p. 36). Pages as printed on the PDF.
note.zh: 每一步学什么，只以这份课纲为准；课里的课纲条目照原文引用，包括「不包括 cm² 与 m² 之间的换算」（第 36 页）。页码是 PDF 上印的页码。

text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore: primary syllabuses page.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部：小学课程纲要页面。

note.zh: 用于核对 S1 的版本。

text.en: TIMSS 2015 Encyclopedia. Singapore: The Mathematics Curriculum in Primary and Lower Secondary Grades. TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center, Boston College.
text.zh: 《TIMSS 2015 百科》新加坡条目：小学与初中的数学课程。波士顿学院 TIMSS & PIRLS 国际研究中心。

note.en: The Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract approach: squares laid and sides walked on the stage, the number sentence under them.
note.zh: 「具体—图像—抽象」教学法：舞台上铺正方形、沿边走，下面写算式。

text.en: Battista, M. T., Clements, D. H., Arnoff, J., Battista, K. & Van Auken Borrow, C. (1998). Students' spatial structuring of 2D arrays of squares. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 29(5), 503–532.
text.zh: Battista, M. T. 等（1998）：学生对二维正方形阵列的空间结构化。《数学教育研究杂志》第 29 卷第 5 期，503–532 页。

note.en: Rows and columns of a square array; counting sides against counting squares (steps 03 and 06). DOI checked 2026-10-14.
note.zh: 正方形阵列的行与列；数边与数格的区别（第 03、06 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-14 核对。

text.en: Outhred, L. N. & Mitchelmore, M. C. (2000). Young children's intuitive understanding of rectangular area measurement. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 31(2), 144–167.
text.zh: Outhred, L. N. 与 Mitchelmore, M. C.（2000）：幼儿对长方形面积测量的直觉理解。《数学教育研究杂志》第 31 卷第 2 期，144–167 页。

note.en: Covering without gaps, units of one size, the row-and-column structure of a rectangle (steps 01, 02, 06). DOI checked 2026-10-14.
note.zh: 铺满不留空、单位一样大、长方形的行列结构（第 01、02、06 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-14 核对。

text.en: Kamii, C. & Kysh, J. (2006). The difficulty of "length × width": Is a square the unit of measurement? Journal of Mathematical Behavior 25(2), 105–115.
text.zh: Kamii, C. 与 Kysh, J.（2006）：「长 × 宽」的难处：正方形是量面积的单位吗？《数学行为杂志》第 25 卷第 2 期，105–115 页。

note.en: Why length × breadth counts squares; adding the sides for an area (steps 02 and 06). DOI checked 2026-10-14.
note.zh: 长 × 宽为什么数的是正方形；把边加起来当面积（第 02、06 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-14 核对。

text.en: Ma, L. (1999). Knowing and Teaching Elementary Mathematics. Mahwah, NJ: Lawrence Erlbaum. Chapter 4: the relationship between perimeter and area.
text.zh: 马力平（1999）：《小学数学的掌握与教学》。新泽西：Lawrence Erlbaum。第 4 章：周长与面积的关系。

note.en: The claim that a bigger perimeter means a bigger area, and counter-examples (step 07).
note.zh: 「周长大，面积就大」的说法与反例（第 07 步）。

text.en: Zacharos, K. (2006). Prevailing educational practices for area measurement and students' failure in measuring areas. Journal of Mathematical Behavior 25(3), 224–239.
text.zh: Zacharos, K.（2006）：通行的面积测量教学与学生在量面积上的失败。《数学行为杂志》第 25 卷第 3 期，224–239 页。

note.en: Area and perimeter confused when formulas come before meaning; the lesson counts before it uses a formula (steps 01–06). DOI checked 2026-10-14.
note.zh: 先背公式、后懂意义时，面积与周长容易混；本课先数格子，再用公式（第 01–06 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-14 核对。

text.en: Common Core Standards Writing Team (2012). Progressions for the Common Core State Standards in Mathematics: K–5, Geometric Measurement. Tucson: Institute for Mathematics and Education, University of Arizona.
text.zh: 共同核心标准编写组（2012）：《共同核心数学标准进阶：幼儿园至五年级·几何测量》。图森：亚利桑那大学数学与教育研究所。

note.en: Area as covering, perimeter as a length, rectilinear and composite figures, and the usual mistakes (steps 03–05, 08–11). The page lists the progressions documents; the Geometric Measurement one is linked from it.
note.zh: 面积是铺满，周长是长度；直线图形与组合图形；常见错误（第 03–05、08–11 步）。该页列出各进阶文件，几何测量一册由此链接。

text.en: Clements, D. H. & Sarama, J. (2014). Learning and Teaching Early Math: The Learning Trajectories Approach (2nd ed.). New York: Routledge. The chapters on length and area.
text.zh: Clements, D. H. 与 Sarama, J.（2014）：《早期数学的学与教：学习轨迹方法》（第 2 版）。纽约：Routledge。长度与面积两章。

note.en: Iterating a unit, half units, units of one size (steps 01 and 02).
note.zh: 单位的重复、半个单位、单位一样大（第 01、02 步）。

text.en: Baturo, A. & Nason, R. (1996). Student teachers' subject matter knowledge within the domain of area measurement. Educational Studies in Mathematics 31(3), 235–268.
text.zh: Baturo, A. 与 Nason, R.（1996）：师范生在面积测量领域的学科知识。《数学教育研究》第 31 卷第 3 期，235–268 页。

note.en: Composite figures: cutting and rearranging keep the area (step 10). DOI checked 2026-10-14.
note.zh: 组合图形：切开、拼合，面积不变（第 10 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-14 核对。

text.en: Dickson, L. (1989). Area of a rectangle. In D. C. Johnson (Ed.), Children's Mathematical Frameworks 8–13: A Study of Classroom Teaching (pp. 89–125). Windsor: NFER-Nelson.
text.zh: Dickson, L.（1989）：长方形的面积。载于 Johnson, D. C. 编《8–13 岁儿童的数学框架：课堂教学研究》，89–125 页。温莎：NFER-Nelson。

note.en: Area of a rectangle, its units, and counting the squares along the edge for a perimeter (steps 03, 06, 08). Page range as cited in the literature; not yet checked against a library copy.
note.zh: 长方形的面积与单位，以及把边上的格子当周长来数（第 03、06、08 步）。页码按文献引用；尚未借阅原书核对。

text.en: Moyer, P. S. (2001). Links to literature: Using representations to explore perimeter and area. Teaching Children Mathematics 8(1), 52–59.
text.zh: Moyer, P. S.（2001）：联系文学作品——用表征探索周长与面积。《儿童数学教学》第 8 卷第 1 期，52–59 页。

note.en: Rearranging the same tiles into shapes with different perimeters (step 07). DOI checked 2026-10-14.
note.zh: 把同样的方砖拼成周长不同的图形（第 07 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-14 核对。

text.en: Textbook series on the MOE approved list (for the usual order of topics and the words length, breadth and "Not drawn to scale" only, not copied): Marshall Cavendish My Pals Are Here! Maths; Shaping Maths.
text.zh: 教育部批准目录上的教材系列（只参考通常的教学顺序和 length、breadth、「未按比例画」等用词，不照抄）：Marshall Cavendish《My Pals Are Here! Maths》、《Shaping Maths》。

note.en: Questions, pictures and wording in this lesson are our own; the numbers are made up and claim no real flat's size.
note.zh: 本课的题目、插图和措辞都是自己写的；数字是虚构的，不代表任何真实户型的面积。
